question: List the five product categories with the greatest all-time item sales.

evidence.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) AS sales_brl FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY sales_brl DESC LIMIT 5

decisions.reason: The question asks for the top five product categories by all-time item sales; the available dataset 'top_categories' directly provides all-time top five categories by merchandise amount.

The question asks only for the five all-time top product categories by item sales. This has already been answered directly by the top_categories query, which returned exactly five categories. The available jul_aug_change metric (a month-over-month difference) is not needed to answer an all-time ranking question, and no decline investigation was requested. No further queries are required.
